title: S2 follow-up: hit-area :is() rule forces position relative on absolutely placed buttons (cards trash, open-beside)
description: Found by agent-e154 (Opus reviewer) after T140 was approved. The S2 hit-area block in src/styles.css (the :is(.icon-button, .delete-entry, ... .topbar > div:first-child > button, .toolbar-icon) { position: relative } rule, about line 342) uses :is(), so every listed element gets the specificity of the most specific argument, (0,2,2). That beats component rules that pin buttons absolutely: .collection-open-beside { position: absolute; right: 4px } (0,1,0, about line 572) and .project-list--cards .delete-entry { position: absolute; right: 3px; top: 4px } (0,2,0, about line 1778). Evidence: Chromium probe of styles.css alone: HEAD cards trash position absolute at top 5, current relative at top 37.5; open-beside absolute at x 166 width 30 on HEAD, relative at x 168.7 width 27.3 now. Built app (ui3-review-e154/dist, port 1654): in Projects cards view the trash computes position relative and sits 46.5 px below the card top instead of 4 px (screenshot node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui3-review-e154/shots/light-cards.png, trash is mid-card beside the date instead of the top-right corner). The source-PDF open-beside button in the sidebar (rows with .has-beside) is now in flow next to .entry-main, which already reserves 40 px padding for it. Same trap T139 round one hit. Fix: wrap that position rule list in :where() (an absolutely positioned button is still the containing block for its ::after, so the 24 x 24 hit area keeps working). Consider :where() for the > svg optical rule too (currently (0,2,3), overrides any future svg transform on these buttons). Add a fail-first Playwright assertion in tests/alignment.spec.ts: in cards view the .delete-entry computes position absolute and its top is within 6 px of the card top; show it red on the current tree. Verify: npx vitest run src/designTokens.test.ts; tests/alignment.spec.ts and tests/projects-screen.spec.ts on a private vite build; light+dark screenshot of cards view. Non-blocking extras from the same review, record or fix: (1) reorder arrows are 20 px wide side by side, so their 24 px ::after areas overlap by 4 px (checklist R2 says never overlap a neighbour); test (b) does not check overlap. (2) No TSX renders className separator, so the .separator recipe and test (e) have no consumer; the horizontal case in test (e) asserts width 1 height 17, which is a vertical rule, not a horizontal one. (3) The grey-box scan in src/designTokens.test.ts misses --selection and only scans :hover/:active, not :focus-visible or [data-highlighted]. (4) .selected { color: var(--text) } near line 620 comes after the recipe accent rule at equal specificity, so the recipe .selected-to-accent branch is dead (no icon button carries .selected today).

Grey-box scan doctored on dropdown.css (:focus-visible with --selection, [data-highlighted] with --line): test went RED naming both; restored, cmp identical. Not run by me: Playwright, dark screenshot (position rule is theme independent). Checklist R2 satisfied.
